class.name: NNBooleanConsideration
class.brief_description: Scores a boolean input with one of two fixed values.
class.description: An [NNConsideration] that converts its input value into one of two fixed scores: [member false_score_value] when the input is below [code]0.5[/code] and [member true_score_value] when it is [code]0.5[/code] or above. It reads its input from [member NNConsideration.input_sensor] or [member NNConsideration.activation_input_value] and inherits [NNConsideration]'s veto check and input-change caching (also recalculating when [member true_score_value] or [member false_score_value] changes), but does not use [member NNConsideration.activation_curve] or a custom [code]eval[/code] method.

method.name: sample_activation_curve
method.description: Returns [member false_score_value] when [param input_value] is below [code]0.5[/code] and [member true_score_value] otherwise. The activation curve is not used.

members.member: The score when the input value is below [code]0.5[/code].
The score when the input value is [code]0.5[/code] or above.
